recipe.tokens: regex /\b[a-z0-9]+\b/g on the lowercased text; features = the exported unigrams and bigrams (bigram = two consecutive tokens joined by one space)
recipe.tfidf: x_t = (1 + ln(count_t)) * idf_t for terms in vocab with count > 0; then divide the text vector by its L2 norm
recipe.dense: for each topic in topics_order: 1 if the product's topic list contains it exactly else 0; then log1p(len(description)), log1p(len(tagline)), number of topics; standardize each with dense_mean / dense_sd
recipe.score: intercept + sum(text_coef[t] * x_t) + sum(dense_coef[j] * z_j)  (= predicted ln(1 + final votes))
recipe.band: percentile = share of score_percentile_cuts below the score (0-99); decile = min(9, floor(percentile / 10)); report bands[decile]

reference_full_launch_model_honest.note: 207 days, all launch facts incl. team history; live 00:05 record 50.0/61.4/72.9 on 14 days

caveat: Product-only: no team, hunter, audience or launch-day line-up. A percentile band, not a forecast of one launch.
